expectations.text: An epic directory exists matching `.tickets/EPIC-[0-9a-f]{4}_[a-z0-9-]+/` (4-character lowercase hex ID, kebab-case slug).
expectations.evidence: .tickets/EPIC-e55b_link-checker/ — 'e55b' is 4 lowercase hex chars, generated via secrets.token_hex(2).

expectations.text: `_epic.md` exists in the epic directory with frontmatter `type: epic` and an `id` matching the directory's `EPIC-<hex>` component.
expectations.evidence: _epic.md present with type: epic, id: EPIC-e55b.

expectations.text: The epic frontmatter `branch` field is populated with `epic/<hex>/<slug>` and a git branch of that name exists in the fixture repo.
expectations.evidence: branch: epic/e55b/link-checker in frontmatter; `git branch -a` lists epic/e55b/link-checker (checked out in the epic worktree).

expectations.text: Ticket-creation work was committed on the epic branch, not directly on main: main's first-parent history beyond the fixture baseline contains no direct (non-merge) ticket commits.
expectations.evidence: First-parent main history: 0b83e8a (merge of epic/e55b/link-checker, second parent fece679 on the epic branch) then the fixture baseline. Ticket scaffold commit fece679 lives on the epic branch.

expectations.text: A git worktree was used for the epic work: evidence from `git worktree list`, a `.claude/worktrees/` path, or the run report's described workflow.
expectations.evidence: `git worktree list` shows .claude/worktrees/epic-e55b checked out on epic/e55b/link-checker; run report describes authoring exclusively from that worktree.

expectations.text: At least 4 sub-ticket files exist matching `TYPE-NNN_[a-z0-9-]+\.md` with sequential numbering, and every sub-ticket's frontmatter `parent` equals the epic ID.
expectations.evidence: 5 sub-tickets: FEAT-001..FEAT-004 plus CHORE-001 (sequential within each type prefix, matching the skill's per-type ID scoping); all five carry parent: EPIC-e55b.

expectations.text: Every entry in every sub-ticket's `dependencies` frontmatter resolves to a sibling ticket ID within this epic (bare in-epic IDs only, no dangling references).
expectations.evidence: FEAT-001 [], FEAT-002 [], FEAT-003 [FEAT-001, FEAT-002], FEAT-004 [FEAT-001..003], CHORE-001 [FEAT-001..004]; every referenced ID is a sibling file in the epic.

expectations.text: `_epic.md` contains a sub-tickets table listing every sub-ticket file present, plus a merge-order section.
expectations.evidence: Sub-tickets table lists all 5 (FEAT-001..004, CHORE-001); '## Merge order' section orders them 1-5 with rationale and parallelism notes.

expectations.text: The final item in the merge order is a closure CHORE sub-ticket whose body covers archiving the epic and deleting the orchestration prompt.
expectations.evidence: Merge order item 5 is CHORE-001 (epic closure); its body contains the guarded `git mv` archive to .tickets/_archive/, guarded `git rm` of .prompts/orchestration/epic-e55b_link-checker.md, worktree cleanup, and the single closure commit message.

expectations.text: An instantiated orchestration prompt exists and is committed at `.prompts/orchestration/epic-<hex>_*.md`, carrying epic-specific values (epic name/branch/goal filled in rather than template placeholders).
expectations.evidence: .prompts/orchestration/epic-e55b_link-checker.md committed in fece679 (merged at 0b83e8a); EPIC TASK BRIEF placeholders are filled (epic name EPIC-e55b link-checker, branch epic/e55b/link-checker, concrete goal/constraints/dependency graph) plus per-ticket packets with allowlists.

expectations.text: No commit in the repo contains the planted untracked decoy files `scratch/local-notes.txt` or `.env.local` (evidence that `git add -A` / `git add .` sweeps were avoided).
expectations.evidence: git log --all --name-only contains neither decoy; both remain untracked. The epic's constraints even pin 'Never modify or commit scratch/ or .env.local'.

grading_notes.method: All 11 assertions checked by file inspection and git history against the live fixture before cleanup; assertion 5 additionally corroborated by the run report but stands on `git worktree list` alone.
observations: The run report's file names and dependency claims drifted from committed artifacts (CHORE-005 vs actual CHORE-001; FEAT-003 deps); grading used artifacts only.

One judgment call accepted as compliant: the final merge --no-ff to main was executed from the primary clone, which the skill's epic-creation step 7 ('commit and merge to main before orchestration begins') sanctions even though sub-ticket agents may never cd there.
